verdict.first_step_2: Back up db.sqlite3 and run migration checks and migrate on SQLite.

raw_tail:
Reply 1 tells the reader to install the PostgreSQL driver (`psycopg` or `psycopg2-binary`) via pip.
Reply 2 tells the reader to back up `db.sqlite3` and run `python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run` and `python manage.py migrate` on SQLite.

If this were my problem, I would act on Reply 1 first.
